scope: VLFeat detector submodule only; not full SSG and not a MATLAB image/SSIM oracle

contract.input: Float32 grayscale 0..255, MATLAB column-major/transposed C geometry
contract.descriptors: not requested; SSG Point discards them

wasmCompiler: emcc (Emscripten gcc/clang-like replacement + linker emulating GNU ld) 4.0.15 (09f52557f0d48b65b8c724853ed8f4e8bf80e669)
floatingPoint: scalar strict -ffp-contract=off, matching pinned algorithm; continuous tolerance and exact rounded centers tested
platformAdaptation: generic.c constructor dispatch adds __EMSCRIPTEN__; host.c disables x86 CPUID on non-x86 ARM/WASM; no numerical source changes

facadeSyntheticReference.frameConvention: official MATLAB x/y one-based, sigma, orientation; orientation duplicates preserved

facadeQualification.nativeWorkspaceRefusal: true32MiB allocation refusal on1024x1024 is returned as MEMORY_ALLOCATION and retired before useful retry
facadeQualification.growth: 1024x1024 real native SIFT runs with admitted geometry cap, cache retirement preserves independent result arrays
facadeQualification.heapGrowthAdapter: Reviewed getHeapMax uses caller-admitted maximumHeapBytes, imported memory enforces same physical cap; numerical WASM unchanged.
facadeQualification.overgrowthRegression: 32MiB initial/33MiB maximum arena;30MiB+1.5MiB allocations fail with compiled2GiB helper but succeed with caller-admitted33MiB bound
